name: iis-hardening-off-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): flips the Saltmarsh IIS site/pool/server into the planted insecure state -- directory browsing on, detailed errors, X-Powered-By/X-AspNet-Version headers, TRACE allowed, site W3C logging off, wildcard :80 binding, Classic pipeline, LocalSystem app pool, unlisted CGI/ISAPI allowed, WebDAV authoring on, no HTTPS binding, no HTTP->HTTPS redirect, and TLS 1.0/1.1 explicitly enabled. Vars: none. Pairs with dir_browsing_off, detailed_errors_off, version_headers_removed, trace_verb_blocked, access_logging_on, apppool_least_priv, apppool_integrated_pipeline, wildcard_binding_removed, https_binding_present, http_redirects_https, tls_legacy_disabled, isapi_cgi_locked_down, webdav_disabled. Depends on iis-ftp-base-win. Idempotent.
script:
Import-Module WebAdministration -ErrorAction Ignore
$site = 'SaltmarshPortal'
$pool = 'SaltmarshPortal'

Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath "IIS:\Sites\$site" `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/directoryBrowse' -Name enabled -Value $true
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath "IIS:\Sites\$site" `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/httpErrors' -Name errorMode -Value 'Detailed'
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath "IIS:\Sites\$site" `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/httpRedirect' -Name enabled -Value $false
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath "IIS:\Sites\$site" `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/httpRedirect' -Name destination -Value ''

Clear-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'IIS:\' `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/httpProtocol/customHeaders' -ErrorAction Ignore
Add-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'IIS:\' `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/httpProtocol/customHeaders' `
    -Value @{name = 'X-Powered-By'; value = 'ASP.NET'}
Clear-WebConfiguration -PSPath "IIS:\Sites\$site" `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/security/requestFiltering/verbs' -ErrorAction Ignore
Add-WebConfiguration -PSPath "IIS:\Sites\$site" `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/security/requestFiltering/verbs' `
    -Value @{verb = 'TRACE'; allowed = 'true'}

Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' `
    -Filter "system.applicationHost/sites/site[@name='$site']/logFile" `
    -Name enabled -Value $false

Remove-WebBinding -Name $site -Protocol http -ErrorAction Ignore
New-WebBinding -Name $site -Protocol http -Port 80 -IPAddress '*' -ErrorAction Ignore

Set-ItemProperty "IIS:\AppPools\$pool" -Name managedPipelineMode -Value 'Classic'
Set-ItemProperty "IIS:\AppPools\$pool" -Name processModel.identityType -Value 0

Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'IIS:\' `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/security/isapiCgiRestriction' -Name notListedCgisAllowed -Value $true
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'IIS:\' `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/security/isapiCgiRestriction' -Name notListedIsapisAllowed -Value $true

Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath "IIS:\Sites\$site" `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/webdav/authoring' -Name enabled -Value $true
Remove-WebBinding -Name $site -Protocol https -ErrorAction Ignore
Get-ChildItem 'IIS:\SslBindings' -ErrorAction Ignore |
    Where-Object { [string]$_.Name -match '!443$' -or [int]$_.Port -eq 443 } |
    Remove-Item -ErrorAction Ignore

foreach ($p in @('TLS 1.0', 'TLS 1.1')) {
    $k = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\$p\Server"
    New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name Enabled -Value 1 -Type DWord
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name DisabledByDefault -Value 0 -Type DWord
}

Restart-WebAppPool -Name $pool -ErrorAction Ignore
Start-Website -Name $site -ErrorAction Ignore
Write-Output 'IIS hardening off'
